data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 潮汐归夜的灯塔低吟
data.action: 赤足坐于栈桥木桩，重剑插在身侧木板，回眸凝视
data.location: 伊比利亚废弃灯塔木栈桥
data.lighting: 清冷月色与泛白浪花的反光交融
data.camera: medium shot, low angle, 码头木桩中景，重剑与夜海浪花同框
data.description: 伊比利亚废弃灯塔旁的临海旧木栈桥上，狂风吹散了夜雾。斯卡蒂赤足坐在微凉的木桩上，巨大重剑插在身旁木板之中，双腿轻垂在拍岸的白色浪沫上方。她微微回首，绯红眼眸褪去了白日的杀伐，在冰凉海风与澄澈月色下多了一分只对博士流露的温软。
data.promptProse: Sitting barefoot atop a weathered wooden pylon at an abandoned coastal pier at midnight, Skadi looks back toward the viewer as white surf breaks against the black rocks below. Beside her, her massive greatsword stands planted in the timber planks, cold moonlight illuminating her tranquil expression against the roaring dark ocean.
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the pier timber beside her planted greatsword, she looks back quietly as cold moonlight catches the breaking ocean spray.
